_about: Daily searches GitHub starts on a timer (.github/workflows/jobhunt.yml and careers.yml, on: schedule). Each entry's cron must match one cron line in that workflow, in UTC (IST = UTC + 5:30). Keys are the workflow inputs; relocation: strict | visa | any. Edit here, no workflow change needed unless a time changes. Career OS directive V2.0 (2026-11-11, see career/): every entry's fit was "strict" (only postings classed 'fit'; stretch and experience-not-stated postings were dropped) and is now "default" (drops only clear mismatches, fit 'no'; stretch jobs stay, flagged as class C). The roles list ended at 'SWE, SDE' before that date; 'senior backend engineer, .NET developer, C# developer, spring boot developer, API developer' were added. Platform / cloud / application / product / systems / distributed systems engineer were deliberately NOT added as roles: the title filter treats a role's distinctive word alone as a match, so they would let in Product Manager, Cloud Sales, Application Support and Systems Administrator titles, while their engineer / developer titles are already kept by the existing 'engineer' and 'software developer' roles.
